svg.title: AKS GitOps Platform Architecture
svg.desc: Terraform provisions Azure infrastructure using a separate Azure Blob backend and bootstraps Argo CD. Argo CD reconciles platform and workload ApplicationSets from Git. Manually built images are pushed to ACR and pulled by the AKS kubelet managed identity. Public HTTPS requests pass through Azure Load Balancer and ingress-nginx to ClusterIP Services and application Pods. ExternalDNS updates Azure DNS using Workload Identity. cert-manager issues certificates with Let's Encrypt HTTP-01. Prometheus scrapes node exporter, kube-state-metrics and kubelet/cAdvisor, stores metrics on an Azure Disk PVC, and Grafana queries Prometheus.
svg.text: Azure infrastructure · GitOps delivery · Automated HTTPS · Cluster observability
Argo CD runs inside AKS; shown here with its delivery inputs.
Argo CD manages add-ons and workloads. Prometheus and Grafana run in the monitoring namespace.
Logical views: deployment control above; Azure runtime below. DNS resolves names; application traffic enters through the load balancer.
